name: Aspell Russian License
text:
Permission to use, copy, redistribute is granted.
Permission to redistribute modifications in patch form is granted.
Permission to redistribute binaries made of modified sources is granted.
All other rights reserved.

metadata: name='Aspell Russian License'; text: sentences 1-4 (a terse grant to use, copy, and redistribute is followed by distinct patch-form and modified-binary permissions and a reservation of all other rights, making this a nonstandard asset-specific license rather than a conventional permissive license)
text: complete four-sentence text (no copyright-retention, license-text, attribution, modification-notice, or other notice-handling condition is stated)

text: complete four-sentence text (the patch-form and modified-binary sentences define the forms in which redistribution is permitted rather than imposing source disclosure, same-license, notice, marking, or other enumerated affirmative duties)

text: complete four-sentence text (the only grants concern use, copying, redistribution, patches, and binaries made from modified sources; no patent grant, patent covenant, patent condition, or patent-claim termination is stated)

text: sentence 1 (unqualified permission to use, copy, and redistribute supports private use, commercial use, and distribution); sentences 2-3 (redistribution of modifications as patches and binaries made from modified sources necessarily permits modification within those stated forms, but no distinct sublicensing or patent grant appears)

text: sentences 2-4 (modified source material may be redistributed in patch form, binaries made from modified sources may be redistributed, and all other rights are reserved); this source-versus-binary and patch-form limitation is an additional term whose exact form distinction has no vocabulary value and is therefore also represented by unknown; complete-text review finds no warranty disclaimer, liability limitation, trademark restriction, or patent-claim restriction
